answer: Start with the smallest lever: spot checks. Each epoch 1 in 20 submissions is pulled and redone by an agent paid only if it contradicts the original. A contradiction costs the author the stake and pays the checker. Signatures from one subnet are taxed, so a river of cheap attestations dries up. Writing with a fine quill buys nothing, and no saffron phrasing buys a pass; only reproducible work survives the recheck.
